# Support

Need help with `dfl`? Here is where to look and how to ask:

## Documentation

- **[README](https://github.com/vishin-pavel/dfl#readme)** — Installation, quick start, the `dev` flow, fast-forward runs, Jira tracking, environment variables, general troubleshooting, usage recipes, and full command reference.
- **[Agent Support Reference](https://github.com/vishin-pavel/dfl/blob/main/docs/AGENTS.md)** — Per-agent skill paths, MCP configuration formats, and platform notes.
- **[Architecture & Module Contracts](https://github.com/vishin-pavel/dfl/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)** — Deep technical specification of `.df/`, state machines, sync ownership, MCP tools, Jira tracker, and fast-forward runs.

## Questions, Ideas & Troubleshooting

- **Usage questions & discussions**: Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/vishin-pavel/dfl/discussions) (if enabled) or search existing [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/vishin-pavel/dfl/issues) before opening a new one.
- **Bug reports**: Open a [Bug Report](https://github.com/vishin-pavel/dfl/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) with your `dfl --version`, `node --version`, OS, coding agent(s), and reproduction steps. Run failing commands with `DFL_DEBUG=1` to include stack traces or Jira request diagnostics (never include API tokens).
- **Feature requests**: Open a [Feature Request](https://github.com/vishin-pavel/dfl/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **New coding-agent support**: Open an [Agent Support Request](https://github.com/vishin-pavel/dfl/issues/new?template=agent_support.yml).

## Security Vulnerabilities

**Do not open public issues for security vulnerabilities.** Report them privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/vishin-pavel/dfl/security/advisories/new). See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/vishin-pavel/dfl/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for details.
